book_name: 同桌英语《刘夏来语料库》3-地图题核心词

words.tr: phrase. 在一边；在某一侧；单方面地
words.ex: She placed the book on one side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在桌子的旁边。
words.en: Situated on one of two opposing sides of something, such as a street or area.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.ex: He is facing a difficult decision.
words.ex_cn: 他正面对一个艰难的决定。
words.en: Facing can refer to the material that covers the outside of a building or structure, or it can mean to confront or deal with a problem or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 被……包围的；被……环绕的
words.ex: The house is surrounded by tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子被高大的树木环绕着。
words.en: If you are surrounded by something, it is all around you.

words.ex: My friend lives next door.
words.en: Adjacent to the current location, typically referring to the house or building immediately beside.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在同一侧；站在同一阵线；意见一致
words.ex: The two boys are sitting on the same side of the table.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩坐在桌子的同一侧。
words.en: Positioned in alignment with another person or object, sharing the same orientation or direction.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: 介词短语. 在我们的右边
words.ex: The park is to our right.
words.en: Positioned to the right side of us or our current location.

words.ex: The book is on the left.
words.en: Located to the left side of something or someone.

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的底部；在……的最下端
words.ex: The cat is at the bottom of the box.
words.en: Located at the lowest part or position of something.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr:
n. 西方；
adj. 西方的；
adv. 在西方；
words.ex: The address is 1071 West Street.
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun sets at the equinoxes, on the left-hand side of a person facing north, or the part of the horizon lying in this direction.

words.ex: The bridge goes over the river.
words.en: Positioned directly above a river, typically on a bridge or bank.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr: phrase. 离……不远；在……附近；接近
words.ex: The park is not far from my house.
words.en: Located at a short distance from a particular place.

words.ex: We played chess indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们在室内下棋。
words.en: Located, done, or used inside a building.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.ex: The flag is at the top of the pole.
words.en: In the highest position or part of something.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: He stopped half way up the hill.
words.ex_cn: 他在爬山到一半时停了下来。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.ex: The sun sets on the western sides of the hill.
words.en: the edges or boundaries of a place that face west

words.tr: phrase. 在马路对面；穿过道路
words.ex: The cat ran across the road.
words.en: Moving from one side of the road to the other.

words.tr: adj. 贴邻的；毗连的； v. “adjoin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two houses are adjoining.
words.en: Adjoining is used to describe something that is next to or joined with something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在…的另一边；在…的远端
words.ex: The cat is sitting on the far side of the room.
words.en: On the opposite or more distant side of something.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He is leading off from the main idea.
words.ex_cn: 他从主要观点开始展开。
words.en: Starting or beginning from a particular point, often used to describe the origin of a path or sequence.

words.tr: adj. 东南的；东南方向的
words.ex: The sun rises in the south-eastern sky.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东南方的天空升起。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of the southeast region.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.ex: The park is on the northeast side of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的东北侧。
words.en: Located on the side that is towards the northeast from a given point or area.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: The number 5 is on the right-hand side of the equation.
words.en: The side of a person or thing that is on the right when facing forward.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的前面；位于……的前部
words.ex: He stands at the front of the class.
words.en: Located at the foremost part or position of something.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: The book is to the right of the lamp.
words.en: Indicates a position or direction that is on the right side of something.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in the corner.
words.en: In the corner refers to being located within the angle formed by the meeting of two walls or other surfaces, typically the inside of a room.

words.ex: The numbers are written along the bottom of the chart.
words.en: Positioned or extending along the lowest edge or bottom part of something.

words.tr: phrase. 从...可见；在...处可以看见

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr: phrase. 在你的右边；在你的右侧
words.ex: The park is on your right.
words.en: Located to the right side of you.

words.ex: The birds fly southwards in winter.
words.en: In a direction towards the south.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: The northern wind is cold in winter.
words.en: Northern means situated in, directed towards, or facing the north.

words.tr: phrase. 在中间；正当…的时候
words.ex: The cat is in the middle of the room.
words.en: Located at an equal distance from the edges or ends of something.

words.tr:
n. 西北；
adj. 西北的；
words.ex: The storm is moving from the northwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴正从西北方向移动。
words.en: The northwest is the direction which is halfway between north and west.

words.tr: adj. 右手的；右侧的；用右手做的；得力的
words.ex: He writes with his right-hand side.
words.en: The right-hand side or part of something is the side or part that is towards the right.

words.ex: At the end, we all went home.
words.en: At the end refers to the final part of something, either in terms of time or space.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.ex: The western section of the city has many parks.
words.ex_cn: 城市的西区有许多公园。
words.en: the part of a place or area that is in the west

words.ex: The book is on the right.
words.en: Located on the side of the body that is toward the east when one is facing north.

words.tr: phrase. 朝向顶部；接近上端
words.ex: The bird flew towards the top of the tree.
The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.ex: There is a bathroom on every floor.
words.ex_cn: 每一层楼都有一个洗手间。
words.en: Located on each level of a building or structure.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.tr:
n. 东方；
adj. 东方的；
adv. 在东方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.en: The direction towards the point of the horizon where the sun rises at the equinoxes, on the right-hand side of a person facing north.

words.ex: The cat is close to the box.
words.en: Near to someone or something in distance or time.

words.ex: The left-hand side of the equation is 5.
words.en: The side of a person or object that is on the left when facing forward.

words.tr: phrase. 在另一边；在对侧；在相反的一方
words.ex: The park is on the other side of the street.
words.en: On the other side refers to the opposite side or aspect of something.

words.tr:
n. 南方；
adj. 南方的；
adv. 在南方；
words.ex: The sun rises in the east and sets in the south.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起，在南方落下。
words.en: The south is the direction which is on your right when you are looking towards the direction where the sun rises.

words.ex: Walk straight ahead until you see the bank.
words.ex_cn: 一直往前走，直到看到银行。
words.en: directly forward; in a straight line.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 正对面的；正对面的位置
words.ex: The park is right opposite the school.
words.en: Directly facing or across from something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在底层；在地面层；在初创阶段（比喻义）
words.ex: The café is on the ground floor.
words.en: On the ground floor means at the level of a building that is at or nearest to the ground.

words.tr: phrase. 就在它过去一点；刚过它
words.ex: He walked just past it without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他从它旁边走过，没有停下。
words.en: Located immediately beyond a specific point or object.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: phrase. 直角弯头；成直角的弯曲部分
words.ex: The road makes a right-angle bend at the corner.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在拐角处有一个直角弯。
words.en: A sharp turn that changes direction by 90 degrees, forming a right angle.

words.ex: The dirt pathway led to the small house.
words.ex_cn: 这条土路通向那座小房子。
words.en: A pathway is a track that is made by or for people walking, especially one through a countryside or a park.

words.tr: phrase. 主路径；主要通道；主干道
words.ex: The main path leads to the school gate.
words.en: The primary route or direction in which something moves or along which something lies.

words.ex: The train lines run through the city every hour.
words.ex_cn: 火车线路每小时经过这座城市。
words.en: Train lines refer to the tracks or routes on which trains travel.

words.ex: The horses live in the stables near the farm.
words.ex_cn: 马住在农场附近的马厩里。
words.en: A building in which horses are kept.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.w: the central area of the site
words.ex: The main building is in the central area of the site.
words.ex_cn: 主楼位于场地的中心区域。

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: The second building is near the park.
words.en: the building that is second in a sequence or order

words.tr: n. 路旁停车带；临时停车处
words.ex: We pulled into the lay-by to check the map.
words.ex_cn: 我们驶入路旁停车带查看地图。
words.en: A lay-by is a short, widened area at the side of a road where vehicles can stop temporarily.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.ex: The managers met in the boardroom to discuss the plan.
words.ex_cn: 经理们在会议室里讨论计划。
words.en: A boardroom is a room where the board of directors of a company meets.

words.ex: He parked his car in the car park.
words.en: A car park is an area or building where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.ex: Children play on the pavements after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A paved path for pedestrians at the side of a road.

words.tr: phrase. 一个急转弯；一个 sharp bend 指道路或路径上角度很陡的转弯
words.us: ə ʃɑr p bɛndtɜrn ɛt sɪk
words.ex: The car slowed down at a sharp bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的急转弯处减速了。
words.en: A sudden change in direction.

words.tr: phrase. 行人过街道：一个标记的路径，人们可以安全地穿过街道或道路。
words.ex: The child waited at the pedestrian crossing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在人行横道处等待。
words.en: A pedestrian crossing is a designated point on a road at which pedestrians are permitted to cross safely.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He walks to the railway station every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上步行去火车站。
words.en: A railway station is a place where trains stop so that people can get on or off.

words.ex: The park is in the centre of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园在城市的中心。
words.en: The centre of something is the middle of it.

words.ex: He walked into the second room.
words.en: the room that is second in a sequence or order

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: The second turning on the left leads to the park.
words.ex_cn: 左边的第二次转折通向公园。
words.en: The second junction or fork in a road where a turn can be made.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.ex: The car drove slowly on a winding road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓行驶在一条蜿蜒的道路上。
words.en: A road that has a lot of bends and turns.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: He entered the first room and saw a big window.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了第一个房间，看到一扇大窗户。

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The children play in the gardens after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在花园里玩耍。
words.en: An area of land, often near a house, used for growing flowers, fruit, or vegetables, and often containing an area of grass.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.ex: The car turned onto the side road.
words.en: A minor road that runs parallel to a main road.

words.tr: phrase. 交通信号灯；红绿灯
words.ex: The car stopped at the traffic lights.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交通信号灯前停了下来。
words.en: A set of automatically operated coloured lights, typically red, amber, and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.ex: The row of buildings is near the park.
words.en: A line of structures, typically houses or shops, arranged side by side.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: The house has a separate entrance for the basement apartment.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个独立的入口通向地下室公寓。
words.en: An entrance that is distinct and not shared with others, allowing for independent access.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: The chickens live in the farmyard.
words.en: A farmyard is the area of land around a farmhouse, where the farm buildings are, and where animals are kept.

words.ex: The car stopped in the turning area.
words.en: A designated space or area where vehicles can turn around or change direction.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: The train runs on a long railway line.
words.ex_cn: 火车行驶在一条长长的铁路线上。
words.en: A railway line is the track along which trains run, connecting different places.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 第二个拐角；第二个角落
words.ex: He turned at the second corner.
words.ex_cn: 他在第二个拐角处转弯。
words.en: the second turning point at a junction or in a path

words.tr: v. 转；转动；转弯；“turn”的现在分词； n. 转弯处；拐弯处；岔路口；
words.ex: He is turning the key to open the door.
words.en: A turning is a place where a road branches off another road.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: We walked along the line of trees to reach the park.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着那排树走到了公园。
words.en: A row of trees planted or growing naturally in a straight line.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.tr: phrase. 一条短路径；一段短路程
words.ex: He took a short path to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他走了一条短路径去公园。
words.en: a brief walkway or track between two points

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.ex: The starting point is the blue tree.
words.en: A starting point is a place or position from which something begins.

words.ex: The train runs on railway tracks.
words.en: The parallel metal lines on which trains run.

words.tr: phrase. 南入口；朝南的出入口
words.ex: The bus stops at the south entrance.
words.en: The entrance located on the southern side of a building or area.

words.tr: phrase. 残疾人通道；无障碍出入口
words.ex: The building has a disabled entry for wheelchairs.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼设有残疾人通道供轮椅使用。
words.en: An entrance designed or designated for use by people with disabilities, ensuring accessibility.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.tr: n. 交叉；相交；十字路口；交叉路口；
words.ex: The intersection of two roads is busy.
words.ex_cn: 两条路的交叉口很繁忙。
words.en: An intersection is a place where roads or other lines meet or cross.

words.ex: The children are playing on the river bank.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在河岸上玩耍。
words.en: The land alongside a river.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: The children play soccer on the recreation ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场踢足球。
words.en: A recreation ground is an area of land that is used for sports and other leisure activities.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: There are not enough parking spaces near the mall.
words.ex_cn: 商场附近没有足够的停车位。
words.en: Parking spaces refer to designated areas where vehicles can be parked, typically marked by lines on the ground in parking lots or along streets.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: The children played in the woods after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在树林里玩耍。
words.en: A forested area with many trees, often used for shelter or mystery.

words.tr: 旅游信息中心：旅游信息中心是一个提供信息给游客的实体位置。
words.ex: We asked for maps at the tourist information centre.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅游信息中心问了地图。
words.en: A place where visitors can obtain information about tourist attractions, accommodations, and other services in the area.

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 双扇门；两扇对开的门
words.ex: He pushed open the double doors and walked inside.
words.ex_cn: 他推开双扇门，走了进去。
words.en: a pair of doors that open together as one entrance

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.ex: He comes in every morning at 8 o'clock.
words.en: To enter a place, especially a building or room.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.tr: phrase. 前往；朝某方向移动
words.ex: They head to school every morning.
words.en: To move or travel towards a particular place.

words.ex: He went past the store without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他经过商店却没有停下。
words.en: To move past something or someone; to exceed a certain point in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. 走出去；罢工；退场；中断关系或合作
words.ex: He walked out of the room when he got angry.
words.en: To leave a place, especially as a way of showing that you are unhappy or disapprove of something; to stop working as a protest.

words.tr: 短语. 过马路；横穿道路
words.ex: He is crossing the road carefully.
words.en: The act of moving from one side of a road to the other.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.ex: The sun comes out after the rain.
words.en: If something comes out, it becomes known, especially after it has been kept secret or it has been unknown.

words.tr: phrase. 向上朝向；朝着…的上方移动
words.ex: The bird flew up towards the sky.
words.en: In the direction of something that is higher or further along a path.

words.ex: Turn right at the corner.
words.en: To change direction to the right side.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. v. 直走；改过自新，走上正路
words.ex: Go straight to the park.
words.en: To move forward in a straight line without turning.

words.tr: phrase. v. 朝…方向前进；有助于；促成
words.ex: The boy went towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩朝公园方向前进。
words.en: To move in the direction of something or someone.

words.tr:
adj. 分开的；分离的；单独的；
v. 分离；隔离；
words.ex: They live in separate houses.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在分开的房子里。
words.en: To cause to move or be apart; to divide or keep apart.

words.tr: phrase. 下沉；坠落；下降；被接受；传下去；被咽下
words.ex: The sun goes down in the evening.
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower place or position; to decrease in size, amount, or intensity; to be accepted or believed; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: He leads the team from failure to success.
words.ex_cn: 他带领团队从失败走向成功。
words.en: To guide or direct someone or something from one place or situation to another.

words.ex: He walks along the beach every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上沿着海滩散步。
words.en: To move forward on foot, especially in a leisurely or purposeful manner along a path, road, or other route.

words.ex: Take the first right after the bank.
words.ex_cn: 在银行之后第一个右转。
words.en: To turn right at the first opportunity when driving or walking.

words.tr: 短语。横跨水域；越过水面；指跨越河流、湖泊或海洋等水域
words.ex: The boat goes across the water to the island.
words.en: on the opposite side of a body of water from where you are

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.en: To come or go into a place; to become involved in a situation or activity; to begin a particular period or stage; to record information in a book or computer.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr: 短语动词. 低下头；前往某地（尤指向下或朝某个方向移动）
words.ex: He head down when he heard the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时低下了头。
words.en: To proceed or go in a determined manner; to focus or concentrate on a task.

words.tr: phrase. 进入内部；走进里面
words.ex: He will go inside when it starts to rain.
words.en: enter a building, room, or enclosed space

words.tr: phrase. 沿着…步行而下；步行经过
words.ex: He walks down the street to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着街道步行去公园。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace, especially in a specified direction.

words.tr: phrase. 在第一个路口向左转（常用于指路）
words.ex: Take the first left after the bank.
words.en: Turn left at the first opportunity when traveling along a road.

words.tr:
v. 横过；穿过；交叉；
n. 十字架；十字形记号；
adj. 恼怒的；
words.ex: Please cross the street carefully.
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; to place or lie across something else; to oppose.

words.ex: The sun comes into the room in the morning.
words.en: To enter a place, state, or condition; to inherit something; to begin to be involved in something.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.tr: phrase. 开始；率先；作为开端；首先发言
words.ex: He will lead off the meeting with a short speech.
words.ex_cn: 他将用一段简短的演讲开场。
words.en: To begin something, especially a discussion, game, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.tr: phrase. prep. 远离；离开（某人或某物）
words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.en: at a distance from a particular place or person

words.tr: phrase. 更进一步；走得更远
words.ex: The company decided to go further in expanding its market overseas.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定进一步拓展海外市场。
words.en: To extend or advance beyond a certain point or limit.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.tr: phrase. 直到（某个时间或级别）；向上穿过（表示范围或过程的延续）
words.ex: He worked up through the ranks to become manager.
words.ex_cn: 他通过逐步晋升成为经理。
words.en: continuing up to and including a particular point in time or space

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.tr: phrase. 走得太远；做得太过分
words.ex: He said something rude; he has gone too far.
words.ex_cn: 他说了句粗鲁的话，太过分了。
words.en: Exceeded reasonable limits or boundaries.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.w: take a look at your plans
words.tr: phrase. 看一下你的计划（短语动词，表示检查或审视某人的计划）
words.uk: teɪk ə lʊk æt jɔː r plænz
words.us: teɪk ə lʊk æt jɔr plænz
words.ex: Take a look at your plans for tomorrow.
words.en: Examine or review your plans carefully.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: phrase. 又对了；恢复正常；再向右
words.ex: You are right again.
words.en: Right again: correct once more; having been accurate a subsequent time.

words.ex: Turn left at the corner.
words.en: To change direction towards the left.

words.tr: phrase. 四处走动；绕行；散步
words.ex: He walks around the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园里散步。
words.en: To move about on foot in a leisurely or aimless manner.

words.tr: phrase. 在桥的另一边；越过这座桥
words.ex: The village is over the bridge.
words.en: over the bridge: crossing from one side to the other using a structure that spans a gap

words.tr: phrase. 向左弯曲绕行；指道路、线路等呈弧形向左转弯
words.ex: The road curves round to the left after the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在树后向左弯曲。
words.en: Turns or bends in a curve towards the left side.

words.tr: phrase. （道路、河流等）分岔，岔开；从主干分出
words.ex: The road branches off near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路在公园附近分岔。
words.en: To diverge or separate from a main path or route.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.
